name: When should I consider replacing my existing baseboards?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my existing baseboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing existing baseboards if they are significantly damaged, show signs of water damage, or if you are undertaking a major renovation and want to update your home's aesthetic. Outdated styles can make a home feel dated, and replacing them can significantly enhance the overall look and feel of a room. If you're planning new flooring, replacing baseboards at the same time can ensure a seamless transition and a cleaner finish. For homes in areas like Meridian or Eagle, updating baseboards can be a key component in a modern refresh.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace baseboards if they are damaged, outdated, or during a renovation, especially with new flooring, to update your home's aesthetic.
